name: cedservice-verticals
description: CED Service growth platform — assessment verticals, Business Record, and intelligence layer.

scripts.test:all: npm run test:unit && npm run test:integration

comments.moduleFormat: Deliberately no "type": "module". The shared/ schema files are dual CommonJS/browser scripts loaded directly by static pages with no build step; declaring the package as ESM would break both. Server code uses .mjs, which Node and Vercel treat as ESM regardless.
comments.dependencies: @supabase/supabase-js is the only production dependency and is imported lazily inside the endpoint, so the unit suite runs without it installed. test:integration DOES require it.
comments.testScripts: test and test:unit are deliberately identical and never touch a database — the default must be safe. test:integration writes permanent, append-only rows to a real Supabase development project and refuses to run without explicit opt-in. test:integration:local runs the same suite against a disposable PostgreSQL created inside the process, with no credential and nothing to leave behind. test:migration covers the migration chain itself: a clean install and an upgrade over populated pre-0006 data. test:browser drives the real page in headless Chrome over http. See tests/integration/README.md.
comments.devDependencies: Both are test-only and neither is imported by any shipped file. @electric-sql/pglite is PostgreSQL compiled to WebAssembly and is what makes real-Postgres validation possible with no Docker, no daemon and no hosted project. puppeteer-core drives a browser the machine already has and downloads none.
